title: Kind of 3.5 Stars
text:
Kind of 3.5 Stars. I have had a reading pillow for over 45 years. My original one finally succumbed to age and I've been looking for a replacement. This will do until something better comes along.

Pros:
Nice fabric and pattern. Very neutral.

Cons:
Impossible to get the headrest buttoned on. The button holes are too small I guess. Whatever reason, I messed with it for 15 minutes and finally gave up.

It is not very firm and supportive by any means. The old one I had was a beast. Stuffed full and firm. This is really wimpy. I use mine sometimes on my futon for watching TV and I can feel the wooden slats through this.

It is also kind of narrow. If you are a large person, you don't want this. I am 5 '2 and 150 and it works for me, but there isn't a lot of wiggle room.
